name: IR Receiver Sensor
fullName: TSOP1738 / VS1838B 38kHz Infrared Remote Receiver Module
tagline: Demodulates 38kHz infrared pulsed signals from handheld remote controls
description: The TSOP1738 / VS1838B is a miniaturized receiver for infrared remote control systems. It integrates a PIN diode, preamplifier, and bandpass filter tuned to 38 kHz to demodulate infrared codes from consumer remotes (NEC, Sony, RC5) into clean digital pulses.

pinout.name: Signal
pinout.desc: Demodulated digital pulse stream to microcontroller

wiringNote: Add a 100uF decoupling capacitor across VCC and GND if your circuit suffers from motor noise.
commonMistakes: Reversing VCC and GND pins (check manufacturer pinout as some modules swap VCC and Signal)
Using blocking delays in loop() that miss incoming IR pulse trains
